text.text_excerpt: My gf and I stopped in briefly last weekend while we were walking along Magazine Street. This place is fairly new and I think it has a lot of potential. They have a decent wine selection, especially French and domestic, as well as a pretty good local beer and liquor selection. They also have some nice wine/beer/liquor/bar tools and gadgets. The staff seemed very friendly and welcoming and were eager to help. I'm excited to see how this place progresses in the next couple months.

I went to this cute wine store the other day in search of an elusive pinkish-hue Reisling I purchased from a wine tasting class during my undergraduate years at Chimes in Baton Rouge. While I did not find it, I enjoyed speaking to the girl who was stocking the fridge and I checked out what kinds if things they have in stock. They have a decent selection of beers, but it's mostly comprised of local flavors. They have a plentiful selection of French and new age reds, but their Spanish red collection could be improved upon. Their staff was friendly and knowledgeable, and they had a nice selection if fun wine accessories. I believe this place will only get better! I believe they only recently...

LOVE that they have unique wine, liquor, beer, and gifts all in one place always open at convenient times. OVERALL: A good stop for unique wine, spirits, and beer, they have a refrigerated section if you're on your way to a party or a parade. You don't normally think of a wine store for gifts, but the front of the store is devoted to unique items in the kitchen and bar category. The owners and staff are wonderful. They always have something amazing to recommend, and the selection is constantly being updated to bring new, unique favorites into my life. BONUS: they can and will special order!
